method: ground profile read every 1 m from the drawing; trend = rolling median over `smoothing_window_m` + rolling mean over 51 m; Ramer-Douglas-Peucker on the trend with the vertical `tolerance_m`; each break stitched to the raw ground (moved up to 30 m to a sample within 0.3 m of the trend); segments shorter than `min_segment_m` merged; no reverse slope in the flow direction (breaks of a climbing segment dropped, `min_slope_m_per_m` is the smallest fall allowed)
calibration: engineer's sample SAK-CH3-SM GDP (5 PVIs): 0.87 m from the 201 m trend, 2.25 m from the raw ground
source: engineer's reviewed GDP profiles read from the drawing on 2026-10-10 02:13
